page.seoDescription: Buy a professionally designed, fully workable homepage concept for your business for just $199 incl. GST. Ready for the Nifty Websites AI Builder. A smarter way to get online.

props.label: Top
props.html:
Limited introductory price

Your professional homepage concept — for just $199.

One professionally designed, fully workable homepage mock-up, branded to your business and ready to drop straight into the Nifty Websites AI Builder. The smartest, lowest-risk way to see exactly what your new website could look like.

$199incl. GST
Buy the Homepage Concept – $199
Delivered quickly Desktop, tablet & mobile Fully workable static page Yours to keep
See what you get

The kind of homepage we’ll design for you.

A real, on-brand concept for your business — not a template. Here’s an example of the quality you can expect.

yourwebsite.com.au
Not sure yet?

The perfect place to start.

Choosing a web agency is a big decision — and every agency says they do great work. So instead of asking you to just take our word for it, we’d rather show you.

For only $199 you get a real, professionally designed homepage for your actual business — not a template and not a stock demo. It’s the easiest, lowest-risk way to see the quality of our work, picture your brand online, and decide with confidence before committing to anything bigger. No pressure, no big upfront spend — just a genuine look at what’s possible.

What you get

Everything in your $199 concept.

A complete, ready-to-use homepage — designed to impress and built to work.

Designed & branded to you

Professionally designed around your business, your colours and your message — not a generic template.

Modern, responsive design

Looks sharp on desktop, tablet and mobile, so every visitor gets a polished experience.

Fully workable static page

A real, working page — ready to deploy straight into the Nifty Websites AI Builder.

Great for approvals

Perfect for presentations, sign-off with partners, or as the foundation to build your full site from.

Delivered quickly

No long waits. Your concept is turned around fast so you can get online sooner.

One round of revisions

Once your concept is ready, you get a complimentary round of changes to fine-tune it to your agreed brief.

It grows with you

Use it today. Grow it anytime.

Your $199 is never wasted — your concept can go live now, or become the start of your full website.

Option 1 — go live now
Use it as a landing page

Deploy your concept as a single-page site straight away and start putting your business in front of customers. A fast, affordable way to get online today without waiting on a full multi-page build.

Option 2 — upgrade anytime

Love the design and want to keep going? Continue it into a complete, multi-page website and your $199 comes off the price of the full build — you simply pay the difference. Nothing you spend today is lost.

How it works

Three simple steps.

1

Buy your concept

Secure your $199 homepage concept in a couple of clicks and tell us about your business.

2

We design it

Our team designs a professional homepage branded to your business, to the specifications we agree.

3

You review & refine

You get a complimentary round of revisions to fine-tune it within your agreed brief — then it’s yours.

Good to know

Fair, clear & upfront.

We keep our terms simple so you know exactly what you’re getting for this special price.

All designs are non-refundable

Because each concept is custom-designed for your business, purchases are non-refundable once your design work has begun.

One complimentary revision round

After your concept is delivered you get one round of changes — your chance to review it and request adjustments before it’s finalised.

Changes stay within the agreed brief

Revisions are made to the specifications we agree at the start. Reasonable tweaks are welcome; brand-new requirements outside the agreed scope aren’t included in the concept price.

Why it’s only $199

This is a genuine introductory offer. We’re pricing it low on purpose — to prove why businesses choose Nifty over any other agency, and to let our quality speak for itself.

By purchasing you agree to these terms. Your concept is designed to the brief agreed at the start of your project, includes one complimentary revision round, and is non-refundable once design work has commenced.

A smarter way to get online

Ready to see your business online?

Grab your professionally designed homepage concept today for just $199 — the easiest, lowest-risk first step to a website that works.

Buy the Homepage Concept – $199
Only $199 incl. GST Delivered quickly $199 credited if you upgrade

data.name: Web Design Agency Australia | Nifty Websites Australia
data.description: Australian web design agency that builds websites designed to rank, convert and drive growth, with a complete SEO build included on every site.

makesOffer.name: Website with a complete SEO build included
makesOffer.description: Every website includes an SEO build set up for you, covering SEO-optimised content, schema markup, technical SEO implementation and Google Search Console and Analytics setup.

mainEntity.name: What does Nifty Websites Australia do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nifty Websites Australia is an Australian web design agency that builds strategic websites for small and growing businesses. Every site is designed to rank in search, convert visitors into enquiries and drive growth, and includes a complete SEO build set up at launch.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the free SEO build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every website includes SEO-optimised content, schema markup on every page, technical SEO implementation, and Google Search Console and Analytics setup, configured for you at launch.

mainEntity.name: How much does a website cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nifty Websites Australia builds Starter sites from $699 and Professional sites from $1,499 on its own Nifty platform. eCommerce and custom builds on WordPress, Shopify or other platforms are quoted on enquiry. Every website includes a complete SEO build and a fixed quote before any work begins.
